subject: general
question: As on 30th June 2022 , how many Schedules are there in the Indian Constitution?
solution:
The correct answer is __**12**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• The** Government of India Act of 1935 contained 10 Schedules**, while the adopted Constitution of India in** 1949 included 8 Schedules.**
 
• As of 30th June, The Indian Constitution has 12 schedules and 448 articles written in 25 parts.
 
• Also, 104 amendments have been made in it until now.
 
• It was also the world's lengthiest written Constitution at the time of its commencement with 8 schedules and 395 articles in 22 parts. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 
 
**Schedule**

 
 
 
**Description**

 
 
 

 
 
First

 
 
 
List of states and union territories

 
 
 

 
 
Second

 
 
 
Provisions of important functionaries

 
 
 

 
 
Third

 
 
 
Forms of Oaths or Affirmations

 
 
 

 
 
Fourth

 
 
 
Allocation of seats in the Council of States.

 
 
 

 
 
Fifth

 
 
 
Administration of Scheduled Areas and Scheduled Tribes.

 
 
 

 
 
Sixth

 
 
 
Administration of Tribal Areas in the States of Assam, Meghalaya, Tripura and Mizoram

 
 
 

 
 
Seventh

 
 
 
Union list, State list and the concurrent list

 
 
 

 
 
Eight

 
 
 
List of recognized languages

 
 
 

 
 
Ninth

 
 
 
Validation of certain Acts and Regulations

 
 
 

 
 
Tenth

 
 
 
Disqualification on ground of defection

 
 
 

 
 
Eleventh

 
 
 
Powers, authority and responsibilities of Panchayats

 
 
 

 
 
Twelfth

 
 
 
Powers, authority and responsibilities of Municipalities
